title: Fantasy Foosball Year 8, 2026 — Week 2 Preview
subtitle: With six playoff spots available, early-season modeled chances remain volatile across the league.

playoffModel.description: Seeded Monte Carlo estimate using current record, scoring strength and remaining Sleeper schedule.

teamA.leagueLore: Two-time champion (2020, 2021). Rivals: Parker, Andy, CJ, Alex.

matchups.headline: Payton faces a steep climb against Evan’s early favorite
matchups.paragraph: Payton’s I ♥️ Big Tet-Tees enters Week 2 at 0-1 and ranked 10th, while Evan’s Bonnie Blue 42 is 1-0 and sits first. The model gives Payton a 17.6% playoff chance, rising to 27% with a win and falling to 13.3% with a loss—a 13.7-point swing. Evan’s already strong 91.8% chance moves to 94.6% after a win or 85.9% after a loss. Their rivalry is supplied league lore, adding context to an otherwise highly uneven early-season matchup.

matchups.headline: Undefeated rivals Andy and Alex meet with meaningful leverage
matchups.paragraph: Andy and Alex both bring 1-0 records into this matchup, with Alex ranked fourth and Andy sixth. Alex’s I love big TD’s has the higher modeled playoff chance at 74.4%, compared with 61.7% for Andy’s Long dong silvers. A win would move Andy to 72.9% and a loss to 51.9%, while Alex would reach 81.8% with a win or drop to 65.8% with a loss. Their shared rivalry makes this an early standings test, though Week 2 volatility remains significant.

matchups.headline: A top-three clash separates two nearly identical playoff outlooks
matchups.paragraph: Kane’s Blueballs and CJ’s cjbroadway23 are both 1-0, ranked second and third, and separated by similarly strong modeled playoff chances: 87.6% for Kane and 86.5% for CJ. Kane’s chance rises to 92.4% with a win and falls to 82.4% with a loss. CJ moves to 92.3% after winning or 81% after losing. The model’s swings are modest compared with several other Week 2 matchups, so this battle between early leaders carries importance without radically changing either outlook.

matchups.headline: Kade and Kohlt put early playoff positioning on the line
matchups.paragraph: Kade’s CheesusJesus is 1-0 and ranked fifth, while Kohlt’s kohlt is 0-1 and ranked eighth. The model gives Kade a 65% playoff chance, with outcomes ranging from 73.7% after a win to 54% after a loss. Kohlt’s modeled chance is 26.3%, rising to 35.6% with a win and dropping to 18.8% with a loss. The 19.7- and 16.8-point swings show real early leverage, although Week 2 estimates remain volatile. Their Kane rivalry is part of the supplied lore.

matchups.headline: Parker and Joey seek their first win in a low-odds matchup
matchups.paragraph: Parker’s My BallDak hurts and Joey’s Off Constantly are both 0-1, ranked 11th and 12th, respectively. Parker holds a 17.7% modeled playoff chance, which becomes 24.3% with a win or 10.8% with a loss. Joey’s chance is 14.9%, moving to 20.8% after a win and 9.2% after a loss. The model’s respective swings are 13.5 and 11.6 points, making the result relevant without overstating a season still in its early, volatile stage.

matchups.headline: Cooper and Brae battle from the middle of the early standings
matchups.paragraph: Cooper’s Jack MeHoff and Brae’s Ogles Outlaws are both 0-1, with Brae ranked seventh and Cooper ninth. Brae has the higher modeled playoff chance at 34.1%, compared with 22.6% for Cooper. A win raises Cooper’s chance to 29.9% and a loss lowers it to 15.9%; Brae reaches 43.3% with a win or falls to 24% with a loss. The model shows a 14-point swing for Cooper and 19.3 points for Brae, underscoring meaningful early volatility.
